newsitem.title: UK: Minerva Plc to float with 144 million stg tag.
newsitem.headline: Minerva Plc to float with 144 million stg tag.

text.p: Minerva Plc, a commercial property investment and development company, said on Friday it will float its shares on the London Stock Exchange at 150p.
The float, sponsored by HSBC Samuel Montagu, will value Minerva at 144.0 million stg and raise 70.6 million stg net.
"We look forward with considerable enthusiasm to Minerva's new existence as a listed company and adding value for our new shareholders," said chairman David Garrard.
"The flotation will enable Minerva to take forward its exciting redevelopment plans and to exploit opportunities not previously available as a private company," he said.

The proceeds of the issue will reduce borrowing and fund the expansion and development of the company's property portfolio, including the acquisition of a property in Wigmore Street in the West End of London, which is conditional on the listing.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on November 28.
